policy: A frozen strategy may be stopped before its sample target when its claimed causal predicate is proven false by source-time evidence. This is a mechanism-invalidity decision, not a PnL threshold change. Historical observations remain immutable and queryable; any repaired rule requires a new strategy id, manifest and evidence clock.

dispositions.reason: Source-time autopsy found that zero of 146 inspected fills had a CLOB book predating the Chainlink source event. Every inspected book was 965-2912 ms newer than the source event because H58 compared local packet receipt order rather than source-time causality. The exact rule is invalid and must not emit further intents.

The slower persistence arm remained BTC-concentrated and unstable: its 86-fill doubled-cost total was only +$9.10, its second chronological half was -$19.29, and the latest 37 high-fidelity fills lost $16.08. It is non-promotable and may only return under a separately frozen mechanism.
